profile.description: Turbomecanica SA manufactures and sells engines, mechanical assemblies, and equipment for aircraft and helicopters in Europe, the United States, and Asia. It operates through Manufacturing of Aircraft Parts; Repairs of Engines; and Other segments. The company offers turbo and viper engines; aeronautical components, including various size compressor and turbine casings and disks, sealing rings and diaphragms, transmission gearbox casings and cover assemblies, spinners, links, aerodynamic surfaces control parts, etc.; welded parts, such as thermal insulating blankets, jointing sleeves, combustion chambers, and tubing products; high-tech parts; modernization of Puma helicopters; compressor and turbine disks, sealing rings, and diaphragms; shafts, sealing rings, couplings and nuts using processes as cutting, milling, and turning and grinding; moulds combustion chambers, turbine nozzle guide vanes and casings, thermal insulating blankets, flame stabilizers, and circular-or-oval section afterburning fuel injection rings, and exhaust ducts and various circular section tubing; drawn parts of various shapes, such as cylindrical, conical and tray-shaped parts, as well as with and dimensions; and spare parts for viper and turbo engines. It also provides repair and overhaul services for turbojets and turbo shafts, as well as helicopters. In addition, the company offers heat treatment, surface coating, and welding process services. Turbomecanica SA was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania.
